combo_label: Jobs & Professions × Disney × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Hargreaves chap who eats his breakfast in one second flat; a headlong dash
Loyal reindeer who hauls an ice harvester's sled and craves carrots
Arendelle's queen, who stops hiding her power over frost
The Mr Man from Sleepyland who will not get out of bed; thoroughly bone idle
Street urchin who wins a princess with a lamp and a flying carpet
Bookish village girl who sees past a cursed prince's fearsome appearance
Green Hargreaves fellow who opens other people's letters to see inside; prying
Yellow Little Miss who brings smiles to gloomy Miseryland; warmth from above
Blue star-shaped Hargreaves chap from chilly Coldland; one sudden red-nosed achoo
Rides the cage down the shaft to hack coal from the seam
Red crab and royal composer who wants a princess to stay under the sea
Runs the pass in starched whites, tasting every plate before it goes out
Checks the chart, changes the drip and works the night shift on the ward
